d: What is everything in the universe actually made of? In this video, we explain the Standard Model of particle physics in simple words: the "periodic table" of the universe's smallest building blocks. You'll learn what quarks and leptons are, why matter comes in three generations, how force carrier particles like photons, gluons and W and Z bosons create the fundamental forces, where the Higgs boson fits in, and why this incredibly successful theory is still incomplete.
